title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Double Apple Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Double Apple captures the crisp, juicy flavour of freshly picked apples. A sweet Red Apple note delivers mellow, rounded fruitiness, while sharp Green Apple brings a bright, slightly tangy finish, resulting in a refreshing and well-balanced fruit vape. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, made exclusively for use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Combined, they offer up to 6000 puffs (depending on personal usage) of consistent flavour and vapour production. Dual mesh coil technology enhances flavour delivery and vapour performance, while the auto-refill system and leak-resistant pod design make it easy to use and mess-free. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers fast-acting nicotine satisfaction and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to keep enjoying a flavour-packed and effortless vape.
